chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who sees semen on his clothes after morning has come, while he had not seen in his sleep that he had experienced a wet dream. He said: Let him perform ghusl, wash his garment, and repeat his salat.

key_terms.احْتَلَمَ: to have experienced a wet dream during sleep
key_terms.الْمَنِيَّ: semen found on the clothing, which triggers rulings of ritual impurity and ghusl in this context
key_terms.ثَوْبَهُ: his garment, which must be washed
key_terms.صَلَاتَهُ: his salat (prayer), which must be repeated according to the hadith
key_terms.فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ: let him perform ghusl, the ritual bath required here

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he finds semen on his clothes in the morning but does not remember having a wet dream?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who finds semen on his clothes in the morning without recalling a wet dream. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that he must perform ghusl, wash the garment, and repeat his salat, indicating the practical rulings connected to ritual purity and worship.
